bank.q: We sleep in the ___.
bank.why: Tidur di kamar tidur (bedroom).

bank.q: The books ___ on the shelf.
bank.why: Subjek jamak: are.

bank.q: She is ten years ___.
bank.why: Pola umur: ten years old.

bank.q: You can fly to another island in a ___.
bank.why: Terbang ke pulau lain memakai pesawat (plane).

bank.q: Please ___ your books to page ten.
bank.why: Kalimat perintah memakai verb dasar: open.

bank.q: ___ a park near my house.
bank.why: Tunggal: there is (ada sebuah).

bank.q: A ___ helps sick people in a hospital.
bank.why: Yang membantu orang sakit di rumah sakit adalah perawat (nurse).

bank.q: Look! The dog ___ after the ball.
bank.why: Look! menandakan sedang berlangsung: is running.

bank.q: I like your new shoes. Can I try ___ on?
bank.why: Shoes jamak, posisi objek: them.

bank.q: Babies drink ___ from a bottle.
bank.why: Bayi minum susu (milk) dari botol.

bank.q: We ___ each other since elementary school.
bank.why: Sejak SD sampai sekarang: present perfect (have known).

bank.q: He failed five times, but he did not ___.
bank.why: Give up = menyerah.

bank.q: ___ you like some tea?
bank.why: Would you like ...? dipakai untuk menawarkan dengan sopan.

bank.q: The movie ___ we watched last night was boring.
bank.why: Klausa relatif untuk benda memakai that.

bank.q: She is proud ___ her son's success.
bank.why: Kolokasi tetap: proud of = bangga akan.

bank.q: He refused ___ my invitation.
bank.why: Setelah refuse memakai to-infinitive: to accept.

bank.q: This phone is much ___ than my old one.
bank.why: Much + comparative: much better (jauh lebih baik).

bank.q: This letter ___ in English, not Indonesian.
bank.why: Pasif present: is + V3 (is written).

bank.q: ___ house is bigger than ours.
bank.why: Their = milik mereka. There = di sana; they're = they are.

bank.q: I think Indonesia ___ the match tonight.
bank.why: Prediksi tentang masa depan: will + verb dasar.

bank.q: If he ___ more carefully, he wouldn't have so many accidents.
bank.why: Second conditional: if + past simple (drove).

bank.q: He offered ___ me to the station.
bank.why: Offer + to-infinitive: offered to drive.

bank.q: The flight was delayed ___ the bad weather.
bank.why: Because of + kata benda. Because harus diikuti klausa.

bank.q: I would rather walk ___ take a crowded bus.
bank.why: Pola would rather X than Y: daripada.

bank.q: I was nervous before the speech, but I decided to take the bull by the ___.
bank.why: Idiom take the bull by the horns = menghadapi masalah dengan berani.

bank.q: We must ___ an effort to finish on time.
bank.why: Kolokasi: make an effort = berusaha.

bank.q: We ___ receipt of your application and will reply soon.
bank.why: Formal: acknowledge receipt = mengonfirmasi penerimaan.

bank.q: Don't eat those mushrooms - they ___ be poisonous.
bank.why: Kemungkinan bahaya: could be = bisa saja.

bank.q: The bridge is expected ___ next year.
bank.why: Be expected to + pasif infinitive: to be completed.

bank.q: By the end of this year, she ___ English for ten years.
bank.why: Durasi sampai titik masa depan: will have been + verb-ing.

bank.q: Her apology sounded ___; nobody believed she meant it.
bank.why: Insincere = tidak tulus, cocok dengan tidak dipercaya.

bank.q: We recommend that he ___ late again.
bank.why: Subjunctive negatif: not + verb dasar (not be late).

bank.q: So loudly ___ that the neighbors complained.
bank.why: So + adverb di awal memicu inversi: did + subjek + verb.

bank.q: In formal English, "buy" becomes ___.
bank.why: Purchase adalah bentuk formal dari buy.

bank.q: I ___ sooner quit than apologize to him.
bank.why: Would sooner ... than = lebih memilih ... daripada (formal).

bank.q: You were ___ to submit the report yesterday. Where is it?
bank.why: Be supposed to = seharusnya (kewajiban yang belum terpenuhi).

bank.q: We must take your age ___ account when we design the program.
bank.why: Frasa tetap: take into account = mempertimbangkan.

bank.q: ___ from his expression, the news was bad.
bank.why: Frasa tetap: judging from = dilihat dari.

bank.q: The plan is ___; it will work even if one part fails.
bank.why: Foolproof = pasti berhasil/tidak bisa gagal.

bank.q: ___ knowledge of English opens many doors.
bank.why: Frasa a knowledge of = penguasaan akan, memakai a.

articles.title: The School Library
body: Sita loves her school library. It is a big, quiet room with many books. Every Tuesday, her class visits the library after lunch.
Yesterday, Sita borrowed a book about dinosaurs. The librarian, Mrs. Rina, helped her find it. Sita must return the book in one week.
At home, Sita reads the book before bed. She draws her favorite dinosaur in her notebook. Next week, she wants to borrow a book about the ocean.

qs.q: What book did Sita borrow yesterday?
Who helped Sita find the book?
When does Sita's class visit the library?

articles.title: The Rise of Electric Vehicles
body: A decade ago, electric cars were rare and expensive. Today, they are becoming a common sight on city roads, and many countries plan to stop selling petrol cars within the next twenty years.

Supporters point to clear benefits: electric vehicles produce no exhaust fumes, so city air becomes cleaner, and they are cheaper to run because electricity costs less than petrol. Governments in several countries also give tax discounts to buyers.

Critics, however, mention real problems. Charging stations are still hard to find outside big cities, batteries are expensive to replace, and producing them requires mining rare minerals. Most experts agree the transition will continue, but the infrastructure must grow with it.

qs.q: What do most experts agree on?
Why do supporters say electric cars make city air cleaner?

opts: Charging stations are hard to find outside big cities
